identity: actor_id is established by the local authenticated application session
naming: operations below name business capabilities from the planning document; transport_kinds lists actual SQL wire kinds

transport_kinds.OFFER: Immutable delivery, including a replacement offer linked to the previous invitation
transport_kinds.CANCEL: Terminal cancellation of an invitation or its assignment
transport_kinds.COMPLETE: Manager request for the employee owner to complete an accepted assignment
transport_kinds.RESULT: Authoritative decision/assignment receipt returned to the project owner

operations.invitation.deliver: Employee owner stores immutable offer; hours remain free
operations.invitation.cancel: Employee owner records a terminal cancellation, including reordered delivery
operations.invitation.respond: Local employee accepts or declines their own offer; acceptance checks every workday
operations.assignment.confirm: Project owner records authoritative decision receipt
operations.assignment.cancel: Employee owner ends participation without deleting history
operations.terms.replace: A new offer version requires new consent and replaces old capacity atomically
operations.review.open: Project owner receives authoritative completion receipt before permitting a review

idempotency: Same command_id/source/kind/payload_hash returns saved result; different contents are command_conflict
transactions: Remote receipt and business mutation commit together; local outbox acknowledgment is a separate transaction
